dataset_name: Bangladesh Heritage and Living Artisan Tourism Planner - Curated Grounding Dataset
license_note: Original curated text and structured references; source websites retain their own rights. Verify before commercial reuse.
coverage_note: Selected main tourist destinations and grounded living-artisan hubs with at least one record in each of Bangladesh's 64 districts and all 8 divisions. Coverage of individual crafts, villages and landmarks is selective, not exhaustive.

quality_policy.heritage_scope: Built heritage, UNESCO sites, archaeological sites, folk art, craft maker hubs, traditional food and agriculture, hill and wetland cultural landscapes.
quality_policy.historical_vs_current: Historic associations are different from evidence that makers currently practice at the tourist stop.

artisan_status_values.documented_recently: Named maker area has dated 2024-2026 documentary support, but no individual demonstration guaranteed.
artisan_status_values.established_verify_before_visit: Craft connection is established, but visitor-facing makers must be checked.
artisan_status_values.declining_or_revival: Important fragile or revived craft; availability limited or requires invitation.
artisan_status_values.limited_presence_verify: Some craft or heritage activity locally, but public maker access is unverified.
artisan_status_values.not_primary_artisan_stop: Historical, natural, food or museum stop, not asserted to have on-site artisans.

quality_policy.tourism_safety: Avoid unsupported itineraries that ignore monsoon safety, forest permits, hill travel restrictions, active worship, visitor access, or community consent.
quality_policy.GI_terminology: A product described as GI-related must be checked against current DPDT registered product name and territorial limits; GI status does not imply every stall sells a certified product.
quality_policy.UNESCO_terminology: Only inscription confirmed by UNESCO is called inscribed; pending nominations and tentative sites are not UNESCO-inscribed.
quality_policy.geocoding: District, upazila and named localities supplied; no fabricated coordinates or invented individual maker addresses. Add verified GIS coordinates separately.
